round: 第二轮：更扁平的环境概念稿
intent: 保留场景内容和主体布局，减少立体渲染、纹理和细节，改用概括色块、简化明暗与手绘笔触。

images.name: 01_天气屋全景_平涂概念稿
images.reference: C:/unity project/Weather House/概念设计/2026-10-17_第一轮/01_天气屋与森林全景.png
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: hand-painted environment visual-development concept art for the cozy game "Weather House".
Input image: the supplied image is the EDIT TARGET and a reference for scene content, major silhouettes and layout. Repaint it from scratch in a substantially flatter, more economical 2D painting language.
Primary request: turn the highly rendered source into an authentic exploratory environment color sketch / gouache concept painting. Preserve the recognizable setting and relationships, but simplify aggressively. The user specifically asks for flatter concept art, with visible decisions and artistic abstraction, rather than a polished 3D game screenshot.
Style/medium: opaque gouache and broad digital flat-brush strokes on a very subtle warm paper ground. Organize the entire image into 3–4 large value families. Objects have mostly a local-color shape plus one designed shadow shape; only occasional small highlights. Use confident angular and curved silhouettes, a few lost edges, restrained broken brush marks. Leaves form broad canopy masses; grass becomes broad interlocking color fields with only a few blade marks; stone has 2–3 painted planes; roofing is one clear shape with very few tile indications. Retain a coherent ground plane and overlapping depth, but compress shading and atmospheric effects. Leave generous calm areas; concentrate the few descriptive marks around the house or puzzle interaction. Charming, slightly irregular hand-drawn design.
Palette: muted sage and yellow-green, creamy warm light, slate blue-green shadows, pale cyan sky, a few small ochre/blue accents. Maintain warm inviting storybook feeling.
Constraints: single full landscape painting, wide 16:9. No captions, labels, typography, UI or watermark. No photo textures, 3D render, PBR, ambient-occlusion creases, detailed tree bark, individual-leaf rendering, glossy reflections, volumetric light shafts, depth-of-field blur, tiny decorative detail everywhere, elaborate cloud volume, smooth airbrushed modeling, or heavy black outlines. Do not simply blur or posterize the original. Make an intentionally designed 2D painting, not vector clipart.
Scene invariants: a small cream-plaster and timber cottage with a simple moss-green pitched roof on the left; one large friendly tree beside it; a curving walkable path through the center foreground; a small pond at right; a soft grassy hill behind. Preserve the original composition at the large-shape level. A tiny chibi witch with teal floppy hat and cape, cream tunic, brown boots and wooden wand stands on the path with a rounded squirrel; treat them as simple scale silhouettes. Keep the roof, door, round window and tree hollow legible with a few brush strokes. Remove incidental visual clutter and most foreground flower detailing. The eye should immediately read house, tree, path, pond as four clear painted shapes. Clouds should be one or two graphic pale shapes. Aim for an art director's beautiful working color key, with ample economy and unrendered areas.
